decision_reason: NASA's GSC-17399-1 record identifies Earthdata Search as an open-source NASA data-discovery web application and links users to its live service. The first license-bearing repository commit is dated 2015-08-11; the current app is live and the repository remains actively developed. This is the Earthdata Search application, not the Common Metadata Repository, GIBS, or upstream data services it interfaces with.
